# Sino Trade Link (Full Specification)

> Verified B2B directory and offline sourcing intelligence platform for China's physical wholesale markets.

Sino Trade Link provides 100% free-to-browse verified access to 27,706+ physical factory stalls and wholesale distributors operating inside Yiwu International Trade City (Futian Market Districts 1–5), Huangyuan Garment Market, and the International Production Materials Market in Zhejiang, alongside nationwide China factory procurement (Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Dongguan, Ningbo, Foshan & beyond), plus free Alibaba.com product-link factory sourcing & 1-piece white-label dropshipping with zero monthly subscriptions.

## Core Navigation & Directories

- [Wholesale Market Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory): Search 27,706+ physical stalls, direct factories, and booth coordinates free of charge and request managed factory quotes via Sino Trade Link.
- [Alibaba.com Dropshipping & Direct Factory Agent](https://sinotradelink.com/dropshipping): Paste any Alibaba.com product URL or send a screenshot on WhatsApp for China-wide direct factory pricing, 1-piece blind dropshipping, and low-MOQ consolidation with zero subscriptions.
- [Market Floor Map](https://sinotradelink.com/market-map): Interactive district floor plan and physical navigation guide for Yiwu Futian Market.
- [On-Demand Stall Inspection Concierge](https://sinotradelink.com/concierge): Professional bilingual agent ground service to visit booths, verify stock, and collect real samples ($99–$299 flat fee, zero commission markups).
- [100-Country Sourcing Corridors](https://sinotradelink.com/countries): Landed customs compliance and Ningbo sea/air freight schedules for 100 global import markets.
- [Global Supplier Onboarding](https://sinotradelink.com/for-suppliers): Application portal for verified manufacturers and international trade suppliers to list on the platform.
- [Public Suppliers API](https://sinotradelink.com/api/suppliers.json): JSON feed of verified market suppliers and stall locations.

## Market Districts Overview

### District 1
- [District 1 Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=1): 5,665+ stalls across 4 floors.
- Categories: Toys, plush animals, artificial flowers, jewelry, ornaments, crystal, decorative crafts, and porcelain.
- Floors: 1st Floor (Toys & Plush), 2nd Floor (Jewelry & Accessories), 3rd Floor (Crafts & Porcelain), 4th Floor (Factory Outlets).

### District 2
- [District 2 Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=2): 5,075+ stalls across 5 floors.
- Categories: Hardware tools, locks, electrical equipment, kitchenware, household appliances, telecommunications, clocks, watches, luggage, and bags.

### District 3
- [District 3 Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=3): 5,142+ stalls across 5 floors.
- Categories: Stationery, school supplies, office equipment, eyewear, sunglasses, sporting goods, recreation equipment, zippers, and garment buttons.

### District 4
- [District 4 Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=4): 5,041+ stalls across 5 floors.
- Categories: Socks, hosiery, daily necessities, cosmetics, gloves, hats, footwear, shoes, belts, scarves, and sewing materials.

### District 5
- [District 5 Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=5): 4,100+ stalls across 5 floors.
- Categories: Home textiles, bedsheets, curtains, raw textile fabrics, auto parts, vehicle accessories, and imported international food & lifestyle goods.

### District 6 (Huangyuan Garment Market)
- [Huangyuan Market Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=6): 1,850+ apparel stalls across 8 floors.
- Categories: Men's apparel, women's fashion, jeans and denim, children's wear, knitwear, and leather outerwear.

### District 7 (Production Materials Market)
- [Production Materials Directory](https://sinotradelink.com/directory?district=7): 464+ industrial supplier stalls.
- Categories: Plastic injection molding supplies, packaging materials, commercial printing, machinery accessories.
